usageNotes: Use this to list all SDN DNS provider integrations configured in the cluster. Requires 'SDN.Audit' or 'SDN.Allocate' on '/sdn/dns/<dns>' — callers only see entries they have permission on. Currently the only supported provider type is 'powerdns'; use the optional 'type' filter to scope results when you only care about that provider.

examples.summary: List all configured SDN DNS providers

tips: The response array may be empty if no DNS integrations have been configured under Datacenter > SDN > DNS.
Each returned object includes a 'dns' field (the zone/config name) and a 'type' field — use the 'dns' value as the identifier when querying individual DNS config endpoints.
PowerDNS is the only type currently enumerated; passing any other value to the 'type' filter will return an empty list.
